title: Geothermal heat pumps don''t make sense financially, so why do we always use them?
summary: An off-grid home builder argues geothermal rarely pays back over air-source heat pumps but can cut solar and battery costs for larger off-grid homes in colder zones.

assertions.quote: the efficiency you gain doesn't pay for itself over the life of the system which is the case in most situations

verdicts.note: With modern cold-climate air-source units, the running-cost gap is small relative to the installation premium unless incentives are large.
